description: This source file implements WebRTC data channel handlers for a Cuttlefish project, managing various data channels such as input, ADB, Bluetooth, camera, sensors, and location channels, including message parsing, state changes, and message dispatching.

classes.name: DataChannelHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling WebRTC data channel events, including message sending and receiving, state changes, and message processing.

classes.name: InputChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles messages on the input data channel, parsing JSON events such as mouse, keyboard, and touch events.

classes.name: ControlChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles control messages for device state, display, and button events.

classes.name: AdbChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles ADB messages over the data channel.

classes.name: BluetoothChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth messages over the data channel.

classes.name: CameraChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles camera data, including EOF markers.

classes.name: UnknownChannelHandler
classes.description: Handles messages on unknown channels, primarily logs warnings.

classes.name: DataChannelHandlerImpl
classes.description: Template class implementing specific data channel handlers, managing registration and observer pattern.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message over the data channel, either as raw bytes or JSON.

methods.name: OnStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the data channel.

methods.name: OnMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages on the data channel, invoking specific message processing.

methods.name: OnDataChannelOpen
methods.description: Dispatches new data channels to appropriate handlers based on label.
